name: Flexi Menu – Create Floating, Sticky, Dropdown & Icon Menus Easily
author: Wow-Company

sections.description:
Flexi Menu is a highly customizable and easy-to-use WordPress plugin that enhances your website’s navigation with flexible menu options. Whether you need a floating, sticky, dropdown, static, or context-based menu, Flexi Menu provides a seamless experience with an intuitive interface. It is perfect for improving user navigation and accessibility on your website.

With Flexi Menu, you can create professional and engaging menus without any coding knowledge. The plugin supports multiple menu types and advanced customization options, allowing you to tailor the menu design to match your website’s aesthetics.

Additionally, Flexi Menu is designed for high performance and responsiveness, ensuring that your menus look great on all devices, including desktops, tablets, and smartphones. The integration with FontAwesome allows you to enhance your menus with icons, while the test mode feature lets you preview menus exclusively for administrators before making them live.

Features:

  • Fully customizable menu design with a user-friendly interface.
  • Multiple menu options: floating, sticky, dropdown, static, and context menus.
  • Menu live builder for easy customization.
  • Responsive and mobile-friendly design for seamless navigation on all devices.
  • Integration with the latest version of FontAwesome for enhanced icon support.
  • Test Mode – allows menus to be visible only to administrators before publishing.
  • Supports various item types, including links, login, logout, reset password, register, email, and telephone.
  • Support for icons and custom styling.
  • Works seamlessly with any WordPress theme.
  • Lightweight and optimized for performance.

Support

Search for answers and ask your questions at support center
sections.installation:
• Installation option 1: Find and install this plugin in the Plugins -> Add new section of your wp-admin
  • Installation option 2: Download the zip file, then upload the plugin via the wp-admin in the Plugins -> Add new
    section. Or unzip the archive and upload the folder to the plugins directory /wp-content/plugins/ via FTP
  • Click Activate when you have installed the plugin via dashboard or press Activate in the Plugins list
  • Go to Flexi Menu section that will appear in your main menu on the left
  • Click Add new to create your first menu
  • Set up your menu
  • Click ‘Save’
sections.faq:
How to use the plugin on a multisite?

To use the plugin on a multisite, do not network activate it. Instead, activate the plugin individually for each site in the network.

Is Flexi Menu compatible with my theme?

Yes, Flexi Menu is designed to work with any WordPress theme without conflicts.

Can I use multiple menus on the same page?

Yes, you can create and manage multiple menus independently.

Does Flexi Menu affect website performance?

No, Flexi Menu is lightweight and optimized for speed to ensure minimal impact on website performance.
